From today, Runna subscribers can use the new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details below.

Runna adds smart training tool for hot weather

Personal running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at supporting users throughout their entire training cycle, from training in hot weather to post-race recovery, leaving nothing out.

Starting today, users can access the new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which helps users find cooler times to run and suggests adjusted pace targets based on felt-like temperature, workout duration, and the specific session.

"Adapt for Heat" displays a colour-coded hourly weather forecast, allowing users to quickly identify the most suitable times to run and schedule their training accordingly.

Here is Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once a user starts a race plan ranging from 5km to 50km, the system automatically generates a relevant programme. Steph Kessell, Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury."

Finally, the platform also announced a new feature, "Upcoming Plans," to be launched in August, allowing users to schedule multiple training plans in advance and seamlessly transition to the next one automatically after a plan ends, further simplifying long-term training workflows.

Here is Runna's overview of the benefits of the "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your year of training in minutes: Runners can stack multiple races, progressive goals, and training phases, keeping their year of training in clear view. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—your preferred training schedule, projected race times, and current fitness level are automatically carried over to the next plan when the current one ends. Complete flexibility, full control: Each plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's expert coaching team based on established training principles, supporting sustainable progression, recovery, and race-day readiness.
